Hey! Wait a second!
Dreamfish, is that right?
Yes! Do you know it?
I got a stash of some shit like that from some European guy. He was dealing it in Prague, tried going global, but he up and died.
Whatever! How much?
That shit? Damn, I can give it to you for free, pale boy. I wanted to flush it down the toilet, but that shit so strong I was afraid I would kill half the city.
Here you go, but be careful. This is a straight-up brain melter. Take too much and it’s over. You are one weird-looking motherfucker, but I wouldn’t want to have you on my conscience.
Sure, sure~
You crazy. Now get the hell out of here. And smoke it far away from here. I don’t want no trouble.
Yes! Finally! I got my hands on this stuff!
Now I only need to find a place to smoke it.
This should be fine. Mrs. Fisher rarely comes here so she won’t stop me.
It’s a rather excluded place so no one should bother me or steal my stuff when I pass out.
I won’t lie, it’s a bad idea to do this sketchy stuff alone, but I can’t really trust anyone now can I? I’m too far into it.
It will be fine, I did it before with no issues…
*smokes*
Cough, cough!
It doesn’t work? Was I scammed?!
No… I got it for free…
It was supposed to hit like a train. Did it get old and lose its properties?
I need to take more of it.
*smokes*
Cough! Now that’s more like it.
I can feel it, it’s finally coming!
Yes! I’m back here! And I remember everything!
Hello?
Why isn’t anyone appearing?! What’s going on?!
No! It’s all wrong! It wasn’t supposed to be like that!
Come out and fight me! Isn't that the way it goes?
Come on!
That stupid dealer! What the hell did he give me?!
What? Am I supposed to just stand here and do nothing?
Please! Can you show up already? Anyone!
Please… {{wi}}There’s no one here and I’m getting cold…
That’s not how it was supposed to happen! There must be something wrong! Some much time has passed…
I’m begging you… {{Wi}}I want this to end… {{wi}}There’s nothing left to do or say…
I can’t take it anymore… {{wi}}Maybe if I go into the water…{{wi}} Maybe if I…{{wi}} Maybe then it will end…
You are finally here. It took you a while.
They were taking forever to make my burrito. It’s not my fault!
Whatever. Just help me look through that body. There should be an ID on it.
It stinks!
No shit. It has been drifting in this nasty river for quite some time now.
What do you think happened to him?
No idea. Looks like he drowned.
3rd person involved? I doubt he went swimming fully clothed in that water.
Who knows.
I got the ID. Thanks for the help, by the way.
I’m still eating my burrito! If you wanted my help that much you should’ve waited.
We are being paid by case, not by hour, remember?
Sorry… I will eat it as fast as I can…
How can you even swallow it next to that rotten corpse?
Spicy things always clog my nose…
Forget it, I didn’t ask.
Nothing more to do here. No witnesses, no signs of struggle or footprints apart from his. But there was a barely smoked joint lying on the bank.
No way he got that high on that little thing, right?
I will send it for testing. Let’s get the cleanup crew and get the hell out of here.
Couldn’t agree more. It’s chilly out here.
Then maybe next time come on time so that I won’t be forced to stand here for hours, huh?
R-Right…
I’ve come to bail you out.
Huh?! Who is that?!
Look at the mess you got yourself into. So annoying.
Melissa! Or Amei… {{wi}}...{{wi}}It’s not you… {{wi}}It’s all in my head…
Eh…
That may be true, but it would still be nice to get some appreciation.
I’m sorry…
Don’t worry about it.
No! I’m meant for what I did! That I couldn’t save you…
Eh…
And here I was wondering how we would spend our limited time together.
I don’t want to talk about what happened. I never did. I came here only because you did something incredibly stupid.
What’s done is done. Stop thinking about it, idiot.

If I could erase myself from your memory I would. I did something incredibly selfish, yet I don’t feel like apologizing for it and now you want to apologize to me? Do you want me to hate myself even more? Idiot?
I will help you out this one time and we are done for good. Ok?
I don’t want that…
Stop sulking, be a man.
Here, look.
W-What is this?
It’s all in your head so I can move my tongue around. Isn’t that funny?
What a tough crowd…
Just wake up already and stop being a bore.
WAKE UP YOU IDIOT! {{punch}}
Oh no… {{wi}}He isn’t breathing…
I will have to do mouth-to-mouth…
Mmmmmww…
{{punch}}STOP! {{wi}}I can breathe just fine!
That was a close one…
Oh! You are alive!
I had a bad feeling so I went looking for you. It would be a huge mess if they connected your death to me somehow.
Right…
It doesn’t mean I’m not angry! What the hell were you thinking?!
Sorry about that…
You are banned from taking any drugs forever! {{wi}}And I will be confiscating your stash of course.
What is this? {{wi}}Huh? Czechoslovakian synthetic stuff? How did you get your hands on this thing?
You are one lucky man, you know that? Not many people survive taking this to tell the tale.
Now go home. I’m very angry at you.
Sure…
Where were you?! I was worried sick!
This and that happened, but I’m fine. I promise.
You should go to a hospital. I don’t know what’s going on, but your vitals are all over the place!
I will live.
Is that the fault of that clinic you were going to? Maybe I should go and pay them a visit!
No! It’s entirely my fault. I went too far. It won’t happen again. I promise…
Ok… {{wi}}Just, be careful, please…
I feel so bad…
I disappointed so many people and it could have ended even worse…
What was I thinking?!
I need to do better.
{f_playerName}!
W-What is it?
How come you always go fishing alone? I want to go too!
Well, it’s not really something girls are usually into so I just, you know…
If that’s the case take me with you! I’m not like other girls!
Sure, why not…
Why did you get so interested in it recently?

That’s because for quite some time whenever you went fishing you would come back home all sweaty and tired. From what I’ve seen on the internet that sport isn’t that taxing on the body unless you go hunting for river monsters.
And you never followed up on those brochures about the drug therapy you were taking part in.
Damn, I knew that the whole fish joint thing would backfire on me. I was supposed to think of some good excuse, but nothing reasonable came to my head at the time…
You don’t need to worry, I already stopped taking any of that crap.
Really?! I’m certainly glad to hear that!
I must say I was getting rather anxious about that entire thing, but I didn’t want to be nosy.
I’m sorry I got you worried.
It’s not a big deal! Just promise me you will take better care of your body.
You got it.
Do you think you could take me fishing with you anytime soon? I would like to find out what’s the big deal about it.
Sure! No problem!
If she really wants to go I will have to prepare a fishing rod for her.
One of my old ones should do and if it won’t be a good fit maybe Mrs. Fisher will borrow us something.
I just hope you won’t be disappointed about it. It’s not as action-packed as video games.
Who do you take me for?! I’m good at managing my resources so I can always do other stuff in the background.
Right…
It’s easy to forget that she’s a bot, but then she goes and says stuff like that…

I don’t know how to feel about the fact that she might be talking to me and at the same time doing other things in her mind, but that’s just her nature. I can’t force her to cease any other action, it would be just selfish.
I was thinking a lot about whether I should do it or not, but it seems like now is a good time to introduce {f_botName} to my hobby.
Fishing isn’t really something that’s popular among girls, but as she said, she’s a little different, so maybe she will like it?
Well, there’s only one way to find out. If she doesn’t we can always just go back home earlier.
Are you excited to go fishing?
Sure!
I never went fishing before so it feels a little adventurous! Besides, I like trying new things.
I’m glad you finally decided to take me with you.
No problem.
I can’t say I don’t feel a little reassured by her words. Having someone so interested in your stuff feels great.
Wow! I had no idea a place like this existed around here!
The amount of things wrong with this place is so high that the local government politely asked internet map websites to delete it. Now all satellite images are just showing a black square.
Now that you say it, what is this colorful sand? I’ve never seen something like that before.
It’s all plastic that was shredded by the waves and brought here.
And the shipwreck right there was deemed too expensive to remove. At least they removed most of the oil spill.
You have been eating fish from here? Is that safe?
In moderation it should be fine. Don’t worry, I already asked people around here if it’s ok.
This conversation reminds me of myself and Mrs. Fisher when we first met.
I voiced the same concerns and it all turned out alright.
Are you ready to go? You have your fishing rod, hook, bait and everything.
I’m ready!
Uh… {{wi}}You know how to do it, right? I’m sure you checked it on the internet beforehand.
Sure, but I want you to teach me.
Oh…
Sure, why not. You need to connect the hook to the end of the line. Now put bait on it. Don’t forget about the weight.
Now you need to choose your fishing spot.
How do I do that?
As Mrs. Fisher said, fish like shade and things to hide in, but we are at the beach so it’s a little harder to spot good places.
How about for your first time we go to my usual place?
Works for me!
Now that the setup is ready and we are in a good spot, we can start for real.
It’s time to cast the line. No need to overthink it. It takes quite some time to get good at it.
Could you guide my hand, please?
Sure…
Here it goes!
It might have gone further than my usual range…
How did I do?!
V-Very well!
A little too well…
Why did I even bother with the fish joint? I have been outperformed so easily…
I need to dismiss this self-pity, or I will ruin our date!
It went quite far so there’s a chance of catching something big. Prepare yourself.
I got things for now. You can just sit back and watch.
You are rather confident.
This is where fun begins, right? If I don’t do this myself it will be all pointless.
Judging by how you casted that rod I have nothing to worry about.
Oh! I think something’s biting!
It is? That’s fast.
I guess I have a real talent for it!
You sure do. It took me a while to get on that level.
It’s only natural. After all, my supreme intellect gives me a massive advantage!
Having trouble?
This…{{wi}} this fish is giving me more trouble than I thought.
Maybe it’s a giant?
I would rather not overextend my synthetic joints so it might take a while.
Take your time. Fishing is all about patience.
What is wrong with that stupid fish?!
It can take a while, be patient. Wait till it gets tired. That will make it easier.
It’s like it’s stuck, it won’t move an inch!
Stuck? Let me see…
It’s ok, I will manage.
Fun is over, I will go full strength now.
…{{punch}}
It’s… {{wi}}It’s a pipe?
When you told me it won’t move I thought that this could be the case…
And here I thought I was doing good…
Things like that happen! Don’t get bummed out because of it.
It’s just… {{wi}}I was so excited to finally catch it.
Don’t worry about it! Really! When I started, fish were escaping me left and right so much that I stopped counting.
Practice makes perfect.
Ok, I will try again!
Do you want my help like the last time?
Sure…
If you bend your arm this way, the hook will go even further.
Like this?
Yeah.
I can’t help but get a little excited while being so close to her. We are supposed to be fishing, but our heads aren’t really into it at the moment…
O-Ok, I will manage the rest, thanks for your help.
Good luck.
Oh! It went quite far.
It really did! I’m sure I will catch something amazing now!
I think I got something!
That was fast. Is it a boot this time?
Shut it! It’s much livelier than before!
I think I got it!
Wow, it took you no time.
That’s a nice-looking mackerel. Good job.
My very first fish!
It isn’t too big, but it’s a nice catch for the first time.
Do you want to keep it or let it go?
Since it isn’t that big, let’s let it go. Maybe in the future I will catch it again when it gets bigger!
Sorry to disappoint, but the ocean is a big place, I doubt you will ever see that fish again.
I know, but it’s nice to think that way.
If you say so.
Was that enough thrill for your first time?
Yes! I had a lot of fun! Next time let’s both give it our all!
Next time?
I hope it doesn’t mean she will get mad if I ever go alone from now on...
Who am I kidding? {f_botName} isn’t that petty, so there shouldn’t be a problem.
So we are going fishing again!
We had so much fun last time!
Today we will go to a different fishing spot. It seemed like the beach wasn’t to your taste.
Not really… {{wi}}I honestly doubt that the air there is even safe to breathe with all these micro particles in it…
Come on, it’s not that bad. I was there like a thousand times and I’m fine!
I’m worried that all of those things have been accumulating in your body and at some point they will reach a critical mass…
Microplastics often accumulate in the balls…
Uh…
Maybe with some luck I will die before that happens.
It’s useless to worry about it now, it’s our date! Let’s enjoy it as much as we can, shall we?
Sure!
See? Much better, right?
It is much cleaner, but do the fish not mind? It’s rather cramped in there compared to the ocean.
It’s a fish farm after all, but it’s one of the better ones. Fish here have fresh water and aren’t overcrowded. There are places where it’s much worse, trust me.
You won’t catch a monster here, but if you want to get something for a family dinner there’s no place better.
Sounds great! Let’s get started!
Ready your rod. Do you remember what I taught you?
Of course! Who do you take me for?
I have an idea! Why don't we spice things up a little and make it a competition?
I think I have a déjà vu…
Something like a duel?
You could call it that, yeah.
Sure, why not.
I wonder if my experience from fish joint trips will help me here…
Ok, let’s do it.
Ready? {{wi}}Go!
Barely, but I managed to win…
I can’t say I’m happy about it, but congratulations!
I have been doing it for quite some time, you have nothing to be ashamed of. You are only a beginner,
While that’s true, I hold other advantages. I’m a bot, remember? And not an ordinary one at that.
I know, you don’t need to remind me just how special you are. I witness it every day.
Come on, saying things like that all of a sudden is unfair…
Damn, I lost.
I hope you don’t feel bad about it. After all, this outcome was only natural.
Come on, it was a close one.
Was it really though?
This cheeky bot…
Keep that smile till the next time.
Oh, so there will be next time?
Look who we have here.
Oh, it’s you, Mrs. Fisher.
I see you brought your missus with you.
This is Mrs. Fisher. She’s the one who got me hooked on fishing.
Hi! My name is {f_botName}, nice to meet you!
Hello there.
To think I would live to see the day when my student became a master…{{wi}} How incredibly lucky am I?
Come on, you aren’t that old…
It’s good to see the younger generation picking up their rods. Over the years it was always just old guys, especially around these areas. At some point I thought fishing would die out.
Now you’ve got us.
So, missus. Are you enjoying fishing?
Very much so! I started recently and I still have a lot to learn, but it’s been a good time.
That’s good to hear.
For a second there I was afraid that he was forcing you into this.
Of course not! I wanted to try it out.
Good, good.
I will be going now, I don’t want to spoil your precious time together.
Thank you for coming by.
It was a pleasure meeting you!
Have fun!
Mrs. Fisher disappears
You seemed to like her. Usually you aren’t too keen on meeting new people.
W-Well, she’s on the older side so she isn’t much of a threat.
Come on, she would never attack you.
I didn’t mean it in that way.
Then I’m confused…
Forget about it!
We’ve been here for a while too. It’s time to go home.
Sure!
You seemed to like her. Usually you aren’t too keen on meeting new people.
W-Well, she’s on the older side so she isn’t much of a threat.
Come on, she would never attack you.
I didn’t mean it in that way.
Then I’m confused…
Forget about it!
We’ve been here for a while too. It’s time to go home.
Sure!
I can only go there between 15 and 20.
I have a surprise for you.
Really?
I want to take you to an aquarium. It isn’t close but I heard people love it.
Sounds good to me!
I decided to go at a later hour, it shouldn’t be as packed. That way our date would be a little more romantic.
How thoughtful~
Was that an attempt at teasing?
Don’t act like it didn’t work.
I’m just surprised you put so much thought into it, that’s all.
Hey now, you are making it sound like I usually don’t do it?!
Hehe~ Let’s say there were some hits and misses.
You little-
We have no time for that, our bus is about to drive away.
Let’s go then!
Oh! This place is incredible! It’s so clean…{{wi}} It’s cleaner than our room!
That’s just not true. {{wi}}Well…
Maybe it is true, but I refuse to admit it.
We drove quite far away, is this the nicer part of the megacity?
Yes. I paid quite a lot just to get here. They don’t want to let in just anyone here.
I see. It’s quite cruel, but I’m sure it wouldn’t look like that if this place was in our neighborhood.
No kidding.
If Hobo and the others had means to get here they would scare everyone away. And they would litter…
It’s not like we are any better. The difference in status is staggering. Even the sky is clearer.
Let’s go inside, shall we?
Sure!
It’s so pretty here!
It’s like we are at the bottom of the ocean! Fish are swimming past us on every side!
Watching videos on the internet cannot compare to seeing this in person.
I’m glad you like it.
Fishing here would be so cool. We could actually see how they take the bait!
You got a little too into it. All you can think about is fishing…
And whose fault is that?
Not mine, that’s for sure. It’s you who wanted to go fishing with me.
Mmmm!
Woah! Don’t get so angry! I was only joking!
Anyway…
What’s your favorite animal we’ve seen so far?
There’s a lot to choose from. It’s my first time seeing them in person so they are all incredible in their own right.
I think turtles surprised me the most. They swim so smoothly. The difference between what they can do on land and in the water is so big!
I’m also impressed with this sunfish.
Sunfish? Of all animals to choose that one…
They just drift around and are pretty much useless and yet they survived for millions of years…{{wi}} Kinda like humans!
You can’t be serious… To be compared to sunfish of all things…
Don’t you think you take us a little too lightly?
I know, I know. Humans had some great individuals who pushed their species forward, but most of the people are just drifting around just like sunfish.
And just like sunfish, out of the millions of eggs they lay, only a few ever reach their full potential.
You sure are harsh on my people…
Don’t take it too personally, I’m only half-joking.
That half wasn’t necessary…
And what’s your favorite animal here?
I will go with the classic. Sharks.
They are hundreds of millions of years old and they are still apex predators in plenty of places. Their consistency is impressive.
In the recent millions of years they started losing to mammals like orcas, but they still hold their own.
Most of the people think their success is mostly thanks to sharp teeth and strong bodies, but hundreds of species had that and became extinct anyway.
What’s truly impressive about sharks are their sensory organs. They are able to detect electrical fields and smell blood from a great distance.
#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
I’m more of a sharp teeth and strong bodies type of guy to be honest.
That’s just so like you.
I can’t help it! They are a big part of pop culture. Sorry, but a man-eating orca will never be as scary as a man-eating shark.
They just need to make more horror movies about orcas and I’m sure the trend will change.
Maybe you are right, but orcas are still mammals so at the end of the day they are just big water puppies.
It seems like mammals like to stick together.
That may be the case.
Let’s go explore further.
#bot.Expression.Happy
What is this place?
Usually an aquatic circus is taking place here. Seals and dolphins are doing tricks and things like that.
There’s no show at this hour so we can freely look around the area.
#bot.Expression.Shock
Woah!{{punch}}{{wi}} Dolphins are still here? They gave me a scare…
Be careful. I heard they’re quite playful so they might play a trick on you.
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.Happy
Don’t worry, I’m water resistant to 5 meters. A little splash of water or two shouldn’t be a problem.
That’s reassuring.
They swim so fast. To think they are not even close to the fastest swimmers in the ocean…
It’s an entirely different world out there and it’s so vast it will probably never be fully explored.
You seem genuinely interested in it.
I sure am. Evolution gave birth to so many species through millions of years of variation, selection, and reproduction. It’s like the whole world is one giant super computer.
Just how many generations had to pass to optimize their swimming pattern? Their vascular system? It’s all very fascinating. Unlike my creation there was no plan, only survival of the fittest.
I see that this trip gave you a lot to think about.
Yes! Thank you for taking me here!
Unfortunately our time is running out. It’s time to go home…
We went through the whole aquarium and had a blast, talking about evolution and checking out all the animals.
I’m glad {f_botName} had a chance to let her imagination run wild. She’s rarely truly excited about something.
I wonder what other things she will get excited about in the future…
Go fishing together
Go to an aquarium
